title: Factorization of the noise kernel along the last coordinate
statement:
Fix $\rho \in \bbr$, points $x', y'$ in the Boolean hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$, and bits $b, b'$. Write $(x', b)$ and $(y', b')$ for the points of $\{0,1\}^{n+1}$ obtained by appending $b$ and $b'$, respectively, as the final coordinate. Then the noise kernel of the extended pair factors as
\[
  K_\rho\bigl((x', b),\, (y', b')\bigr)
  \;=\; K_\rho(x', y') \cdot \frac{1 + \rho\,\chi(b)\,\chi(b')}{2},
\]
where $\chi(\cdot)$ is the $\pm 1$ sign encoding of a bit.
hypotheses_covered: x', y' points of the n-dimensional Boolean hypercube
replaced:
For $x', y' \in \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n$ and bits $b, b'$,
\[
  K_\rho\bigl(\mathrm{snoc}(x',b),\ \mathrm{snoc}(y',b')\bigr)
  \;=\; K_\rho(x',y') \cdot \frac{1 + \rho\,\chi(b)\,\chi(b')}{2}.
\]
